units: Zeb. 106ᵃ כל מקום שנאמר השמר פן ואל וכ׳ wherever the Scripture has ‘be guarded, lest’, or al, it introduces a prohibitory law (v. עָשָׂה); Sot. 5ᵃ, a. fr.

<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 70:2">Sifré Deut. 70</cite>, quot. in <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 882:1">Yalk. ib. 882</cite> <he>השמר בלא תעשה פן בלא תעשה</he> ‘be guarded’ means a prohibitory law, and so does ‘lest’.
